title: Warring States Official Server
description: The Server for my modpack "Warring States - Sengoku Jidai"
body:
The Official Server for my modpack "Warring States - Sengoku Jidai"

Focused on the mod by QwikSand "Sengoku Jidai", the server aims to complement the modpack by giving the community an easy way to group up in game with little to no friction. 

The Server features:
- a 10,240 by 10,240 block world pregenerated for a lag-reduced experience.
- _"Open Parties and Claims"_ for protected base-building with friends and allies, as well as a way to see where they are. 
- _"Easy Homes"_ so you can set up to 3 homes on the server to teleport to at any time. 
- _"Simple Voice Chat"_ for easy communication with those on the server; for both friend and foe alike with an option to set voice chat to private groups.
